one_line: Open on the product already moving, with a one-line headline, then show each page it works with.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a colourful spinning wheel on a stand in a classroom, motion-blurred. No speech. White outlined text, centred over the wheel: "חגיגה של למידה לסתיו עם הגלגל הכי מושלם!". No face.
q1_hook.why: A bright object already in motion fills the first frame (S1, E1), and the headline names the season and promises a ready activity (T3, H2). "הכי מושלם" is a superlative with no proof. There is no face or voice (against H4), so the hook has no sound side (H6).

beats.what: The wheel spins in a classroom; headline over it
beats.why: Moving product with the season and promise

beats.what: Four umbrella worksheets in turn: autumn signs, colours, numbers, shapes
beats.why: A new sheet every second shows the range

beats.what: A designed card, held still: "פעילות חווייתית עם הגלגל ללימוד סימני הסתיו"
beats.why: Explains the how-to, but as a 3 s still with small text

beats.what: Wheel close-up, a finger on a picture disc
beats.why: The only shot of the wheel being operated

beats.what: A child's hand colours a worksheet in a pink sleeve beside a marker basket
Second designed card, held still: "...ללימוד צבעים"
beats.why: Repeats the card pattern for colours

beats.what: Wheel with colour discs, tilt down to the marker basket and the sheet
beats.why: Setup view of the colour version

beats.what: Letterboxed child colouring; text: "הקובץ יעלה לקבוצת הווטסאפ תהנו!"
beats.why: Free file note; not a request

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "למי לשלוח קישור הצטרפות לקבוצה?" (a reply gets the join link) and a free-file promise. The video only says the file will go up in the group; it asks for nothing.
q2_flow.why: A moving wheel then four worksheets in 5 s is a fast, varied start (E1, R3). The two still cards hold small text for 3 s each and the same wheel and sheet pattern repeats (F8, R3). The last 3 s are a letterboxed insert (F1).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:25-0:27: "הקובץ יעלה לקבוצת הווטסאפ תהנו!" (information, no ask). Caption: "רוצו לקנות הוא ישמש אתכן לאורך כל השנה", the file note, and "למי לשלוח קישור הצטרפות לקבוצה?".
q3_cta.why: A free file through a group is a real reason to reply (C2, R6), and the note comes after the demos (C6). But the video never says how to get the link, and the caption adds a second action, "run and buy" (against C1).

q4_shown.what: The wheel spinning 0:00-0:02 and close at 0:11-0:12 and 0:20-0:22; four umbrella worksheets 0:03-0:07; two designed cards 0:08-0:10 and 0:17-0:19; a child's hand colouring in a pink sleeve 0:13-0:16 and 0:25-0:27; a marker basket. No face, price or brand on the wheel.
q4_shown.why: The product moves from 0:00 (S1), and each sheet shows what it is used with. A child's hands colouring is the only proof of use, about 7 s in all (S4). The designed cards are not filmed proof (F8), and without a price or shop name a viewer cannot tell where to buy (C7).

q5_edit.what: About 8 shots in 27.6 s (about 3.5 s each), straight cuts alternating filmed footage with two designed still cards held about 3 s each; handheld close-ups; the last clip is letterboxed with black bars. Headline 0:00-0:02, end text 0:25-0:27. No speech.
q5_edit.why: Alternating shots change the picture about every 3 s (E2), but the stills are static and the card pattern repeats (F8, R3). Black bars in the last 3 s break the full-screen look (F1), and the Reel ends on a text line, not a payoff (R4).

q6_topic.what: A seasonal learning wheel with printable autumn worksheets for kindergarten; it serves gan teachers planning autumn activities.
q6_topic.why: It is tied to a season, a clear planning moment for teachers (K7), and the free printable is the useful part (K4, R7). There is no story, joke or child reaction, so it informs more than it moves (K1, K2). The audience is teachers, not parents.

q7_filmed.what: A static medium shot of the wheel on a classroom table in daylight; handheld top-down shots of worksheets; a handheld wheel close-up with a finger; handheld close-ups of a child's hand colouring; a letterboxed last clip; two graphic cards.
q7_filmed.why: The wheel fills the frame with strong colour from the first frame (F4, H7). Handheld sheet shots are close enough to read (F4), but at 0:13-0:16 and 0:23-0:24 the sheet is turned sideways, so its Hebrew reads vertically (F5). The classroom setting looks natural (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:02 white outlined headline, 2 lines, centred about 44 to 55 percent down: "חגיגה של למידה לסתיו עם הגלגל הכי מושלם!". 0:03-0:07 the sheets' own instruction boxes. Two graphic cards, 0:08-0:10 and 0:17-0:19: "פעילות חווייתית עם הגלגל ללימוד סימני הסתיו" and "...ללימוד צבעים". 0:25-0:27 white text, pink outline, centred: "הקובץ יעלה לקבוצת הווטסאפ תהנו!".
q8_text.caption: "חגיגה של למידה לסתיו🌦️", the same words as the headline. About 40 words in 5 short lines: a question about who lacks the wheel, a buy ask, the free-file note, a question about the join link, 4 hashtags (#גננת #גןילדים #גננות #גננתלגילהרך). No disclosure.
q8_text.why: The headline is large and inside the safe zone (T3, T4), and the caption's first line repeats it (T7). The two stock-style cards carry small text on a still (T2, T5). All meaning sits in text, so it works muted (T1).

weak_points: Two template-style still cards with small text; sideways sheets with vertical text; a letterboxed last clip; two different asks in the caption; no price, shop or way to buy; no voice.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the product moving in frame one with one big headline, then close hand shots of each page. Offer a free printable for one reply; keep the ask single.
not_verified: Speech or music: the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech; music cannot be told. What "תבל" is (a shop, unconfirmed). Whether she sells the wheel or the sheets, and whether she is paid. Who made the graphic cards. No corrections to the first pass.
